context_requirements: Active PI3K/AKT signaling, often via PTEN loss, PIK3CA mutation, or RTK/oncogene activation
Dependence on AKT for survival and proliferation
Intact downstream FOXO and cell-cycle machinery for transcriptional readout
falsifiers: No decrease in proliferation-associated genes (e.g., MYC, CCND1, MKI67, TOP2A) at 24 h in any line
No induction of FOXO target genes (e.g., FOXO3, DDIT4, TSC22D3, GADD45A) at 6 h in PTEN-mutant lines
Strong transcriptional response in HA1E or other lines without PI3K/AKT activation
Lack of dose-dependent or time-dependent changes across all nine lines

evidence.supports: MK-2206 inhibits Akt and enhances antitumor efficacy, supporting AKT as target
GDC-0068 blocks Akt signaling, reduces viability, and sensitivity correlates with PTEN loss/PIK3CA mutation
MK-2206 inhibits Akt signaling and cell-cycle progression; PTEN/PIK3CA mutations confer sensitivity
GSK690693 inhibits proliferation and induces apoptosis in hematologic lines
MK-2206 activates autophagy and apoptosis in glioma cells
